description: In handle_email_set (email.rs:590), update_object::<Email>(&account_id, &id, patch_val.clone()) clones the entire patch JSON Value on every update iteration. The same pattern exists in handle_mailbox_set (mailbox.rs:580) and handle_identity_set (identity.rs:272). For large patches (e.g., setting many keywords) this is an unnecessary allocation. The update_object trait takes O::Patch by value, so the last iteration could move rather than clone. A simple fix: drain the update_map iterator (via into_iter on an owned map) so the last element can be moved. This requires consuming the args object earlier, which is feasible since the update map is processed once. Impact: avoidable clone per update in the hot path.
title: Email/set update: patch_val.clone() on every update; avoidable with Arc
